validation.notes: The record's official_source_url .../news/getfund-opens-applications-for-2026-27-undergraduate-and-postgraduate-local-scholarships 302-redirects to the SPA shell at https://www.getfund.gov.gh/, whose JSON-LD declares the organization as GovernmentOrganization 'Ghana Education Trust Fund' (alternateName 'GETFund'). Visually confirmed in a browser: circular GETFund seal with the Ghana flag rings and figures with children, beside the wordmark 'GETFund / Ghana Education Trust Fund'. The official-domain favicon/site icons (getfund-site-icon-192x192.png, getfund-cropped-icon.png) were rejected. Shared asset URL is used for both GETFund records (685, 718) because both are administered by the same official provider.
